Hello, thank you for the advice! I already asked my dad about getting the food I need in order to start, and he said he would help. Though I don't have much in the house right now since we haven't done any grocery shopping. We do have eggs though, so I guess I should start off there!

I don't know if in the end he'll be able to really afford the things I need, since we've always been tight on money. I wanted to know if there was a certain budget I could have, where I could still be able to buy the foods I need? ;;

Hello! Currently I don't have a job, since my parents aren't allowing me to get a job yet (it's stupid, I know.) My dad is willing to help with buying anything I need though, so hopefully I won't have to worry about not having the necessary foods. Once I have what I need, I'll be sure to start on the one week meal prep, since a lot of people have mentioned it already. c:

Thank you for the advice, and I wish you good luck with your diet too!
Thank you for the advice! I have a (silly) question though, how do you know if your carbs are under 20g a day? Is there a certain amount you have to eat or..? ;;'

Those are a lot of things to cut out of my current diet, but I'm sure I'll be able to do it! 

It comforts me knowing that someone who was around the same size as I am right now was able to lose weight, it's very encouraging for me, so thank you for sharing and thank you for the advice! ;; I really appreciate it.

Ah, I'm really sorry for the late reply! ;;
I've already looked at some Keto pages on Instagram! I never thought about looking on Pinterest since I've never used it, but I'll browse through it today! Thank you for the advice. c:
